heading: INT. BASALT CAVERN OF THE MOON-WELL - NIGHT

units.text: INT. BASALT CAVERN OF THE MOON-WELL - NIGHT
A vaulted cave.
A pool of still, silver water at its center, lit from below.
Stalactites drip in a slow rhythm.
Runes glow faintly on the walls.
PRINCESS LYSANDRA OYELOWO-VANE (20s, travel-worn gown, a sword at her hip) kneels at the pool's edge, cupping silver water in her hands.
She lets it spill through her fingers.
Tell me the way. Tell me the way home.
units.name: LYSANDRA

units.text: The water ripples.
A glimmer rises from the depths and shivers into a voice.
Seek the king's lost daughter.
units.name: MORGWYN

units.text: I am the king's lost daughter.
units.name: LYSANDRA

units.text: Then seek the one who kept you.
units.name: MORGWYN

units.text: A pebble clatters down the cave wall.
Lysandra rises, sword half-drawn.
From the shadows steps a woman in a hooded gray cloak.
MORGWYN ASHWORTH-ABARA (50s, silver hair, a staff of white ash).
She lowers her hood.
Hello, child.
units.name: MORGWYN

units.text: Morgwyn?
units.name: LYSANDRA

units.text: You've grown.
units.name: MORGWYN

units.text: You vanished.
units.name: LYSANDRA

units.text: I was told to.
units.name: MORGWYN

units.text: By whom?
units.name: LYSANDRA

units.text: By the king.
units.name: MORGWYN

units.text: He lied to us both.
units.name: LYSANDRA

units.text: He lied to us both.
units.name: ^MORGWYN

units.text: They stare at each other, startled by the echo.
The silver water stills.
Then who is she? The one who sits on my throne?
units.name: LYSANDRA

units.text: She is your sister.
units.name: MORGWYN

units.text: I have no sister.
units.name: LYSANDRA

units.text: You do now. And she is waiting.
units.name: MORGWYN

units.text: Lysandra sheathes her sword.
She wipes her hand on her gown and steps toward Morgwyn, who lifts the staff and draws a circle in the air.
The circle opens on a green meadow, full of light.
